page.layout: One column of numbered theses, running from top to bottom. Catchword alone at bottom right. No running head, page number or signature printed.

main_text.p: XXII. At iniquas illas comparationes ad ea, quæ omnibus non pariter adsunt. 4.physic.8.
XXIII. Metaphysicam.n.nec Demonstratione, nec Definitione uti, teneri potest. ii.Metaph.2. Logici etiam u-nanimiter.
XXIV. Abstractionem igitur spectas? Ea dictis respondet: in Medis autem Mathematicam ponit. ii.Primæ Phi-lof.Sum.3.c.1.
XXV. Doctrinæ seriem? Mathematica ordinem invertit; & Physicæ ratione. Ex Platon. & Arist.Fr.Patric.

XXVI. METAPHYSICA. Ut autem Philosophiæ istius dignioris, varietas nominum in variam est relata consyderationem; sic splendor dignitatis, vota eidem contribuit: ut Philosophiæ primæ, Philosophiæ eximiæ, Theologiæ, Sapientiæ, Vniversalis scientiæ, &c. i.Metaphys.c.1.&t.50.&1.2.t.3.&1.ii.c.1.&1.6.t.3.&c.
XXVII. De cuius sanè Subiecto quæstio in promptu est: responsio anceps.
XXIIX. Ens, qua ratione Ens est, pro exæquato Subiecto assu-mere, clarissimi quiq; Philosophi, peripateticum statuunt. At illud quid sit, non una est omnium opinio.
XXIX. An quia Ens in iis est, quæ πρὸς μίαν τινὰ φύσιν relata dicuntur? In huiusce modi autem Subiecto scientia proprie primi Philosophi est. ii.Primæ Philos.Sum.2.c.1.&1.4.c.2.
XXX. Ac Entis, prout Ens existit, contemplatio Metaphysica merito dicta. Ibid.

page.notes: The catchword "Neq" carries a mark after the q that could be a subscript stroke or abbreviation; read as Neq[?]. The thesis number after XXIX is printed "XXIIX" and is kept as printed. The reference "1.4.c.2." appears as "I.4" in the scan and is doubtful. Some i/j and u/v spellings were normalised per the rules. The Greek phrase is copied from the scan and may contain small errors.
